people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: Aaron said to them, “Take off the golden rings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them to me.”
translations.bsb: So Aaron told them, “Take off the gold earrings that are on your wives and sons and daughters, and bring them to me.”
